content:wysiwyg_basic:0:45.html:
The Challenge

A National Challenge With Local Impact

The National Commander’s Virtual Red Kettle Challenge invites Advisory Organization members, Salvation Army personnel, volunteers, and supporters to use their networks to help raise funds for their local Salvation Army.

Virtual Red Kettles are organized locally, so participation may look different from one community to another. Contact your local Salvation Army to learn how its Virtual Red Kettle campaign is set up and how you can create, sponsor, support, or share a kettle.

Every gift helps support the work of The Salvation Army in the community connected to that Virtual Red Kettle.

Get Involved

How to Participate

1

Connect locally

Use the location finder to contact your local Salvation Army corps, division, or fundraising representative. Ask how you can participate in its 2026 Virtual Red Kettle campaign.

2

Get your Virtual Red Kettle link

Your local Salvation Army can help you identify the appropriate Virtual Red Kettle or peer-to-peer fundraising option for your community.

3

Share the challenge

Invite friends, family, colleagues, and community contacts to give. Share why supporting your local Salvation Army matters to you and encourage others to pass the invitation along.

4

Help your community

Funds raised through local Virtual Red Kettles help support Salvation Army programs and services in the communities they serve.

Find Your Local Salvation Army

Advisory Organizations

A Special Invitation to Advisory Organization Members

Your leadership and connections can introduce more people to The Salvation Army’s mission and expand support for work happening in your community.

Partner with your local Salvation Army to sponsor or support a Virtual Red Kettle, then invite your personal and professional networks to join you. A simple message, shared with the people who know and trust you, can help make a meaningful local difference this Christmas season.

Connect With Your Local Salvation Army

Join the Challenge

Join the National Commander

The National Commander is participating with a Virtual Red Kettle and inviting others across the country to join the challenge. If you are not connected with a local Virtual Red Kettle, you may support the National Commander’s kettle directly.

Support the National Commander’s Virtual Red Kettle

A Message From the National Commander

Hear the National Commander’s invitation to join the 2026 Virtual Red Kettle Challenge and help build support for The Salvation Army’s work in communities across the country.
